It's a live, iterative collaboration where you describe what you want to build, Claude writes the code, you break it, you ask questions, and something actually functional comes out the other side. For independent artists trying to automate their workflow without hiring a dev or learning a full stack, this approach is surprisingly viable and worth understanding in detail.
